item.title: WATCH | Millions of FMD vaccine doses on the way
item.description: A further 1,5 million doses of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD)vaccine are expected to arrive from Biogénesis Bagó later this week, another 1 million doses in the first week of March and 5 million doses later in March.

item.title: There’s living, and then there’s peak living in the Ford Everest XLT
item.description: Peak living isn’t only about rare moments or far-off destinations – it’s about how confidently, comfortably, and effortlessly you move through every day. Because there’s living, and then there’s peak living in the Ford Everest XLT – an SUV that brings that mindset to life, offering a refined balance of capability, comfort, and smart technology, all from just R953 000.

item.title: New climate-smart manual helps small-scale farmers cut water use and boost yields year-round
item.description: Solidaridad, a global non-profit organisation focused on advancing social justice and sustainability in supply chains, has launched the Climate-Smart Horticulture Production Manual for Small-Scale Farmers. This practical, field-tested guide is aimed at helping farmers adapt to climate change while producing nutritious, market-ready vegetables.

item.title: Heritage Angoras celebrate again with good prices at auction
item.description: The Heritage Angora auction on 28 January was, as usual, a celebration of the mohair industry and the men and women on whom this industry relies.

item.title: Risk and reward – veteran Merino farmer reveals survival secrets for SA agriculture
item.description: In business, the higher the risk the higher the reward. We as farmers are exposed to much the same risks as other businesses, like price risk, theft and political uncertainty. Farmers, however, have the added complication of weather. In South Africa we are either in the middle of a drought or waiting for the next one! This makes controlling and managing risk critical.

item.description: Households and small businesses will have more money left in their wallets thanks to government’s decision to adjust the income tax brackets and thresholds in line with inflation this year.
